title: Random forest predicts severe complications after cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC
summary: A random forest trained on 1955 UPMC patients (37% with severe complications) used 15 variables and reached AUC 0.71 internally. In external validation on 617 patients from the US HIPEC collaborative (22% severe complications), AUC ranged from 0.60 to 0.73, mean 0.65. High peritoneal cancer index, subtotal gastrectomy and low albumin were among the most important variables.
ai_technology: Random forest with recursive feature elimination and SHAP

evidence.tested: External validation in the US HIPEC collaborative dataset.
evidence.unknown: Modest AUC; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Model predicts complications from perioperative variables.
